{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Teacup Town |characters=チャバタウン |japanese=Chaba Town |image=Teacup Town.png |imagesize=250px |region=Unknown |epicode=HZ093 |episode=Clash of the Nidothing Fans |colorscheme=ZA }} '''Teacup Town''' (Japanese: '''チャバタウン''' ''Chaba Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location. The town is surrounded by tea fields and has been described as a place where the fragrant aroma of tea leaves permeates the air[https://twitter.com/anipoke_PR/status/1914967514641322152 アニメ「ポケットモンスター」公式 (@anipoke_PR) - Twitter] (retrieved April 26, 2025). In ''[[HZ093|Clash of the Nidothing Fans]]'', [[Liko]] and [[Roy]] visited Teacup Town to meet with the witness [[Litten Smitten]] after the two received an eyewitness report about [[Black Rayquaza]] from [[Dot]]. Liko was then engaged in a battle against Litten Smitten after the latter found out the two are members of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. The battle was interrupted by [[Ult]], who was being chased by a group of {{p|Dodrio}} and {{p|Fearow}}. After Liko and Roy used their Pokémon to calm down the wild Pokémon, Litten Smitten was convinced of their innocence and revealed that the eyewitness report she provided was false. ==Pokémon seen in Teacup Town== {| style="margin:auto; width: 50%" |- | {{InactivePoké|Teacup Town|Machoke|disp=Machoke|Teacup Town Machoke.png|fighting|link=no}} | {{InactivePoké|Teacup Town|Machop|disp=Machop|Teacup Town Machop.png|fighting|link=no}} | {{InactivePoké|Teacup Town|Dodrio|disp=Dodrio|Teacup Town Dodrio.png|normal|flying|link=no}} | {{InactivePoké|Teacup Town|Fearow|disp=Fearow|Teacup Town Fearow.png|normal|flying|link=no}} |} ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{colorschemedark|ZA}}; border:3px solid #{{unknown color}}" |- ! style="background:#{{colorschemelight|ZA}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{colorschemelight|ZA}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{colorschemelight|ZA}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | チャバタウン ''Chaba Town'' | From 茶葉 ''chaba'' (tea leaf) |- | English, Danish, Finnish,
